subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'. **

One of the baby elephants broke **__off__** from the herd and lost its way.
solution:
The correct answer is **"away"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase **"break off"** means to suddenly stop doing or saying something. 

 
 
• **Example:** He started speaking
